self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Press the Advantage (R5): after defeating an enemy, ATK +24% for 30s, stacking independently up to 3 times. Modeled at max 3 stacks: ATK +72%.

en.flavor: A mysterious catalyst made of a material known as "blackcliff." It has an ominous crimson glow that seems to pulse in synchronization with the tremors from deep within the earth.
